technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with short-term momentum (EMA cross, stoch cross) offset by overbought conditions, MACD weakness, and price below longer-term moving averages—moderate confluence but elevated pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces imminent earnings volatility with no fundamental tailwinds.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (29/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and lightweight with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, crisis VIX at 319) combined with critical earnings binary event in 1 day create extreme risk environment for MMM despite falling dollar tailwind.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with stochastic bullish cross and Awesome Oscillator upside break provide short-term momentum confluence in extreme fear environment (VIX 319) offering contrarian entry near support at 84.09.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary within 1 day combined with overbought oscillators, price below 50/200 EMAs, MACD momentum divergence, and inverted yield curve create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry regardless of technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: EMA 9/21 golden cross with stochastic bullish cross provides short-term momentum confluence at support, but earnings binary within 1 day creates unacceptable risk asymmetry that negates technical setup quality.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 1 day creates binary volatility event that can gap through technical levels regardless of setup quality; overbought oscillators and price below 50/200 EMAs increase pullback probability.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical and sentiment agents show bullish signals, but risk and fundamental agents decisively override with critical earnings proximity and macro headwinds
